documents.doc-cz-md-2026-08-18-md-46042-2026-010-4: The Ministry of Transport deferred the freedom-of-information request concerning the collection, transport and storage of blood samples. It stated that it holds no documents concerning those matters and has never held any, considered the requested information outside its remit, and referred the applicant to the Police of the Czech Republic, the Police Presidium, the Ministry of the Interior or the Ministry of Health.
